description:
Discover this beautiful 80± acre ranch for sale in Hill County, Texas, offering a blend of productive pastureland, scenic water features, and comfortable country living. Whether you're looking for a Texas ranch, horse property, working farm, or weekend retreat, this versatile property has something for everyone.

The ranch features road frontage on two sides, making access convenient, along with three ponds and scenic Turkey Creek winding through the property. Improvements include a renovated 2-bedroom, 2-bath farmhouse and a pole barn, while the land is fully fenced and cross-fenced with an improved hay pasture, making it well suited for livestock, horses, or hay production.

Property Highlights

• 80± Acres in Hill County, Texas
• Road Frontage on Two Sides
• Three Ponds
• Turkey Creek Runs Through the Property
• Renovated 2 Bedroom, 2 Bathroom Farmhouse
• Pole Barn
• Fully Fenced and Cross-Fenced
• Improved Hay Pasture
• Ideal for Ranching, Recreation, or Country Living

Whether you're searching for Hill County land for sale, Texas ranch land, acreage with a farmhouse, horse property, or a working ranch, this property offers the space, water features, and improvements to fit a variety of lifestyles.

📍 Contact the Wise Land Team with Whitetail Properties Real Estate to schedule a private showing or request additional information about this exceptional Hill County ranch.
